quality_assessment: Page provides good coverage of basic output formatting options with excellent visual enhancements, but is missing several important output formats and modes. The hyperlink format table is accurate and matches the source code.

issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting --vimgrep flag which prints results in vim quickfix format (file:line:column:text). Note that each line with multiple matches will be printed multiple times (once per match), which can lead to quadratic output size. Recommend using --json for editor integrations instead.

Add section documenting --json flag for JSON Lines output format. Include the five message types (begin, end, match, context, summary), explain use cases for programmatic consumption, and note that --stats is implicitly enabled with --json.

Add documentation for --stats which prints aggregate statistics (matched lines, files with matches, files searched, time elapsed). Note it's implicitly enabled with --json and has no effect with --files or --files-with-matches.
Document --null/-0 for null-separated output (useful for filenames with spaces in scripting) and --null-data for treating input as null-separated instead of line-separated.
Document buffering modes: --line-buffered for line-by-line output (useful for piping to other commands for incremental processing) and --block-buffered for block buffering (better performance).
Document --max-columns for limiting output width (useful for very long lines) and --max-columns-preview for showing preview of truncated lines instead of omitting them entirely.

issues.should_be: Document --context-separator SEPARATOR for customizing the separator and --no-context-separator for disabling it entirely
issues.fix_suggestion: Expand the note about context separators to include explicit documentation of --context-separator and --no-context-separator flags with examples.
Document --field-match-separator and --field-context-separator for customizing the separators between fields in output (between filename, line number, column number, and match text).
